approvalBasis: User authorized animating remaining models and triggering an enemy death animation when the unit dies. These are initial deterministic death prototypes awaiting full visual approval.
assetPolicy: Read-only source GLBs. Animate the private spawned hierarchy only; no approved source model, geometry, texture, material, rig or gallery is overwritten.

options.groundHeight: World-space horizontal terrain plane; otherwise figure.userData.groundY or0.
options.assetId: Optional explicit canonical host asset ID.
options.preview: Explicit true allows a fresh workshop replay driver on a restored instance; gameplay retains one-shot guard.

api.body: figure.userData.body when present; otherwise figure itself.
api.update: Elapsed seconds since death. Monotonic, clamped to duration, non-looping. Earlier or repeated values cannot restart the fall.
api.sample: Optional deterministic preview seeking in elapsed seconds. Sampling does not rearm or reset the monotonic game clock or finished flag; gameplay should call update only.
api.reset: Restore the exact captured pre-death pose, hierarchy, materials and indicator visibility; mark this driver finished/cancelled. Does not rearm.
api.dispose: Idempotent reset and release only privately cloned death materials and temporary pivot. Never dispose source geometry or materials.
api.finished: True after duration or explicit reset. The final corpse remains rendered until the round owner removes it.
api.rootOwnership: No root position X/Z, root navigation Y, root orientation or source scale change. The private fall pivot owns world-vertical descent inside the actor.

capture.basis: Current rendered pose at actual death, not rest/T-pose; current gait geometry, limb quaternions, body attitude and scaling are retained.
capture.assembly: A pure-translation pivot is inserted below the same parent; its owned children retain exact world transforms at time0.
capture.indicators: Health bar, aura and refraction overlay are hidden, excluded from contact bounds, and restored on explicit reset.
capture.ownership: No severed limbs, gore, detached rider, weapon handoff or new projectile.

grounding.method: Capture all actual rendered mesh position vertices. Re-evaluate their transformed worldY after every death pose, including real semantic joint motion, current root yaw and nonuniform scale. Skinned/morphed vertices use the actual software vertex transform.
grounding.target: Interpolate the captured lowest rendered point toward the supplied terrain plane plus clearance. Flying bodies descend from their actual current lowest point; they do not snap to ground or reset their altitude first.
grounding.scope: Exact bound of the evaluated rendered vertices against a horizontal plane, not physics or terrain triangle contact. Held equipment and wings participate.
limitations: A rigid weapon or wing can support the overall corpse above its torso; articulated release or ragdoll contacts are not implemented.
Inclined/stepped terrain needs a future terrain-sampling contact policy; this implementation accepts a horizontal groundHeight.
Collision between the corpse and other units, buildings or its own attachments is not certified.

anatomyPolicy.ground: Short stagger and forward-side collapse. Knee/hip slackening is added only if real named semantic hinges exist.
anatomyPolicy.wolf: Fore/hind leg hinges buckle when present, then the entire mount rolls onto its side; rider and all tack remain attached.
anatomyPolicy.flight: Wing hinge fold if present; coherent loss of lift, bank and descent of the entire mount/rider assembly. Fused wings are not disconnected or falsely called independently folded.
anatomyPolicy.mechanical: Existing machine hinges slacken; rigid frame/cockpit stays intact. No rubber geometry deformation or explosion.
anatomyPolicy.manta: Nearly flat descent preserves the broad armored center; it does not use a biped vertical-to-horizontal topple.
anatomyPolicy.spectral: Private material clones fade to22 percent of captured opacity and dim emissive light; a grounded translucent corpse residue persists.
anatomyPolicy.hollowArmor: Solid armor remains opaque; only private inner emissive intensity decays. No invisible flesh or gore is introduced.

sharedPhases.name: Current-pose capture
sharedPhases.effect: Exact body pose and source hierarchy are captured before any fall.

sharedPhases.name: Stagger and hinge failure
sharedPhases.effect: Real knee/hip or wing channels slacken from their current pose; a short lateral stagger is strongest before0.23.

sharedPhases.name: Main collapse
sharedPhases.effect: Smooth full-body attitude change with a small transient bank for fliers.

sharedPhases.name: Terrain settling
sharedPhases.effect: World-space support minimum descends to the actual horizontal terrain plane plus clearance; no upward bounce is added.

sharedPhases.name: Spectral/fire decay where applicable
sharedPhases.effect: Owned materials alone dim; physical branches retain their original materials.

sharedPhases.name: Persistent final corpse
sharedPhases.effect: One shot finishes and stops evaluating; corpse removal belongs to round cleanup.

qaRequirements: Trigger death during a moving gait and verify no reset to rest or jump at time0.
Verify each of the54 IDs, including all4 explicit wraith variants, resolves to the correct branch.
View the entire fall from front, profile and game camera, checking equipment, rider/collar support and silhouette.
Check no corpse penetrates the horizontal ground plane under actual battlefield scaling and heading.
Confirm duplicate death events and earlier elapsed times never restart a corpse.
Confirm reset/replay is explicit workshop behavior and shared cached assets remain unchanged.
Review wing/knee channels honestly: current flat fused geometry may provide only coherent body fall, not separate joint folding.

targetedTests.scope: Synthetic actual Three.js hierarchy tests: all54 dispatch/current gameflying flags; captured non-rest pose; one-shot duplicate/monotonic clock; scale/yaw grounding acrossallbranches; material isolation/residue/disposal; deterministic samples and exact reset/hierarchy restoration.
